explanations.how_to_fix: Connect the other end, set the duty on the stream by hand if it is a boundary energy input, or delete the stream if the unit computes its own duty from a temperature specification.
explanations.meaning: An energy stream is attached to a unit at one end only.
explanations.title: Energy stream with a loose end
explanations.why: An energy stream carries a duty: heat into a heater, work into a pump, heat out of a cooler. A unit in Energy Stream mode reads its duty from the stream, so the stream needs a value from somewhere. One loose end means the duty comes from nowhere, or goes nowhere.
